blendVariants.label: Natural
blendVariants.title: Reserva Especial El Jocko Natural
blendVariants.summaryHtml: Cedar, cream, roasted nuts, cinnamon, earth and restrained pepper give the El Jocko Natural a brighter profile than the Broadleaf Maduro without turning mild or bland. The Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper softens the darker edges while the Dominican core supplies body and savoury depth. Its perfecto shape starts concentrated, opens through the broad middle and finishes on cedar, nuts and warm spice.

note: Nest the existing standalone blend counterpart under la-flor-dominicana-reserva-especial-el-jocko-maduro using the Blend dropdown. Preserve the parent entry as the baseline/default blend and do not copy or overwrite unrelated parent fields.
